Grok CLI as a fourth agent

Features·seedling·proposed·JUL 09, 2026

Plan for first-class Grok Build (binary `grok`) support — a sibling AgentAdapter that detects sessions under ~/.grok, surfaces state on the dock/tile, and joins claude · codex · opencode in the closed agent union.

xAI ships Grok Build — a terminal coding agent whose binary is grok. Kolu already treats any shell program as a terminal; what it doesn’t do yet is treat Grok as one of the three icon-capable agents (claude-code · codex · opencode): no tile chrome, no dock pip state, no worktree-leaf resume, no palette kind bridge. This note is the plan to add it as a fourth full adapter, not a detection-only basename.Detection-only agents (aider, goose, gemini, cursor-agent) only enter STABLE_FLAGS so the command palette remembers them. They never join AgentKindSchema or get a state indicator. Grok is in the full-adapter set because users run it as a primary coding agent the same way they run Claude / Codex / OpenCode — the bar is parity with that trio, not with the MRU-only list.

What ships

Run grok in any kolu terminal → tile chrome shows a Grok icon and live state (thinking / tools / waiting / awaiting you), the dock ranks it like the other agents, sleep/restore resumes with grok -c or grok --resume &lt;uuid&gt;, and the worktree agent picker can re-launch the normalized command. One PR.

Shape

Same cut as every existing agent: a sibling package under packages/integrations/, implementing anyagent’s AgentAdapter, owning its own *InfoSchema, and joining the closed union one layer up. No new electricity — session files on disk are a bounded algorithm (leaf), not a transport/reconnect receptacle.

Layer What changes
kolu-grok (new) Adapter + session resolve + events tail + schemas
anyagent STABLE_FLAGS["grok"], BASENAME_TO_KIND, AGENT_RESUME, AgentKindSchema
@kolu/terminal-workspace AgentInfoSchema arm + startAgent(grokAdapter) in sensors
client GrokIcon, agentIcons / agentNames entries
e2e grok.feature + fixture writer (mirrors codex/opencode)

On-disk facts (verified)

Grounded in a live ~/.grok install (Grok Build beta, binary /home/…/.local/bin/grok → ~/.grok/bin/grok). The marketing name is “Grok Build”; the process basename and CLI entrypoint are grok.

~/.grok/
  active_sessions.json          # [{ session_id, pid, cwd, opened_at }, …]
  sessions/<urlencode(cwd)>/
    <uuid>/
      events.jsonl              # phase_changed · tool_* · turn_started/ended
      summary.json              # model, title, created_at, cwd
      chat_history.jsonl        # full transcript (export later)
      updates.jsonl             # ACP-style session/update stream
      …
  • Session id is a UUID (observed as uuid-shaped; often uuidv7-like). Resume: -c / --continue (most recent in cwd), -r / --resume [<SESSION_ID>] (exact).
  • Cwd encoding is full URL-encoding of the absolute path (/home/… → %2Fhome%2F…) — same idea as Claude’s project-dir encoding, different alphabet.
  • Live process map is active_sessions.json (pid + cwd + session_id). This is the preferred match signal — analogous to Claude’s ~/.claude/sessions/<pid>.json.
  • State stream is events.jsonl. Observed phase_changed.phase values: waiting_for_model, streaming_reasoning, streaming_text, tool_execution, permission_prompt. Turn lifecycle: turn_started / turn_ended (outcome: completed | cancelled).
  • Metadata lives in summary.json: current_model_id, generated_title / session_summary, created_at, info.id, info.cwd.

There is no SQLite session DB for the TUI path (unlike Codex / OpenCode). Watchers are plain fs.watch / refcounted dir watchers on JSON files — same family as Claude’s transcript tail, not the WAL path.

State fold

Map the last meaningful event after the latest turn_started (or turn_ended if no open turn) onto the shared agent-state vocabulary. Do not invent a fifth paint class — reuse the closed set the Dock already folds.

Grok signal AgentInfo.state
open turn + permission_prompt (and no later phase) awaiting_user
open turn + tool_execution tool_use
open turn + waiting_for_model / streaming_reasoning / streaming_text thinking
turn_ended with no subsequent turn_started waiting
matched session, no events yet thinking (bootstrapping)

running_background is out of scope for v1 (Claude-only today — dynamic workflow journal). Grok’s parallel subagents do not yet expose an equivalent on-disk journal kolu can observe without screen-scrape guesswork.

Honest nulls on first ship:

  • contextTokens: null — no stable context-window counter found in summary.json / events.jsonl (unlike Codex’s token_count / OpenCode’s tokens.total). Do not invent a percentage from num_messages.
  • taskProgress: null — plan entries appear in updates.jsonl (sessionUpdate: "plan") but are optional and shape-unstable; leave for a follow-up once the plan event is pinned.

Filled fields:

  • sessionId ← summary.info.id / active_sessions.session_id
  • model ← summary.current_model_id
  • summary ← generated_title ?? session_summary
  • startedAt ← parse created_at to epoch-ms

Session match

Prefer the pid map, fall back to cwd:

  1. If matchesAgent(state, "grok") is false → null.
  2. Read active_sessions.json. If an entry’s pid equals state.foregroundPid → that session_id (+ cwd-encoded path for the events file).
  3. Else look under sessions/<urlencode(state.cwd)>/ for the most recently updated_at (or mtime) session directory that still has a summary.json.
  4. No row / no dir → null (watcher not created).

externalChanges.isPresent is true when matchesAgent(…, "grok") or ~/.grok exists — same lazy-install pattern as Codex (packages/integrations/codex/src/agent-adapter.ts:42-48). install watches active_sessions.json (and optionally the sessions root) with the existing refcounted dir-watcher helper so a brand-new machine that never ran Grok pays zero watcher cost.

Resume + CLI allowlist

Extend anyagent in the three places a resume-capable agent always touches (packages/integrations/anyagent/src/agent-cli.ts:52-179):

// STABLE_FLAGS
["grok", new Set([
  "--model", "-m",
  "--always-approve",
  "--permission-mode",
  "--agent",
  "--no-plan",
  "--no-subagents",
  "--reasoning-effort", "--effort",
])],

// BASENAME_TO_KIND / AgentKindSchema
grok: "grok",

// AGENT_RESUME
grok: {
  last: "-c",
  byId: (id) => `--resume ${id}`,
  idPattern: UUID_RE, // same shell-safe UUID gate as claude/codex
},

-p / --single (headless one-shot) is an exit-immediately style invocation for our purposes only when the process ends — do not special-case it in parseAgentCommand; if someone runs it interactively it still normalizes. Prompt positionals are already stripped by the existing positional-drop rule.

Client surface

Minimal, exhaustive:

  • GrokIcon in packages/client/src/ui/Icons.tsx (simple monochrome mark that reads at 12–16px — no wordmark).
  • agentIcons / agentNames grow a "grok" arm in packages/client/src/ui/agentDisplay.ts:9-22.
  • agentShortName already returns kind as-is for non-claude-code (packages/terminal-workspace/src/agentProjection.ts:57-60) — no change.
  • Dock / fleet paint folds over AgentInfo["state"] only — a new kind does not touch agentProjection state switches. Exhaustive match sites over agent.kind (transcript export, any icon tables) gain one arm; TypeScript flags them.

Transcript export (same PR if cheap, else follow-up)

padi/src/transcript.ts already matches on agent.kind for HTML export. A loader that maps chat_history.jsonl → Transcript is desirable but not blocking for the chrome/dock story. Default: ship the adapter without export in PR1; add loadGrokTranscript when the JSONL schema is pinned by the fixture tests. The error string that lists agent names updates either way.

Tests

Mirror the codex/opencode pattern — fixture writer, not a live Grok binary in CI:

  1. Unit (packages/integrations/grok/): encode-cwd, resolve from a synthetic active_sessions.json + session tree, state fold over a scripted events.jsonl (thinking → tool_use → waiting; permission → awaiting_user), agentInfoEqual stability.
  2. anyagent unit: parseAgentCommand("grok -m grok-4.5 …"), resumeAgentCommand for -c and --resume <uuid>, refuse malformed id.
  3. e2e grok.feature: fake agent process named grok + write fixture under a temp HOME/GROK_HOME override if the adapter honors an env for tests (preferred) or points at a tmpdir via the same test seam codex uses. Assert tile chrome kind=grok and state transitions after fixture rewrites.

Pin GROK_HOME (or reuse HOME with only ~/.grok populated) so tests never scan the developer’s real sessions — same isolation rule Claude tests already follow for ~/.claude.

One PR, done criterion

A single conventional-commit PR (feat: detect Grok CLI sessions) that:

  1. Adds packages/integrations/grok (kolu-grok) with grokAdapter.
  2. Extends AgentKindSchema + resume/allowlist tables.
  3. Registers the adapter in startSensors.
  4. Adds client icon + display tables.
  5. Passes unit + a grok.feature e2e path that proves the adapter path (fixture → resolveSession → watcher → tile kind/state), not merely “palette remembers the string grok”.

Out of scope (explicit):

  • Headless / ACP bot integration.
  • Screen-scrape promotion (no evidence Grok buffers prompts off-disk the way Claude’s AskUserQuestion does).
  • Token % / plan checklist chrome.
  • README marketing line (“claude, codex, opencode”) updates — do them in the same PR only where a table already enumerates the three; no README rewrite for its own sake.

Risks

Risk Mitigation
Grok renames phases / moves home dir Zod-parse events with unknown-phase → thinking; config constant for home (path.join(os.homedir(), ".grok")) + GROK_HOME override for tests; schema tripwire test listing known phases
permission_prompt flickers under --always-approve / yolo Fold only the latest phase after debounce (~50–100 ms, same family as other watchers); yolo resolves permissions in the same event batch so a single read of the file tail lands on tool_execution
Multiple sessions per cwd Prefer active_sessions pid match; cwd fallback takes max updated_at / mtime — document as “foreground Grok for this cwd”
Binary named something other than grok on some installs Match basename grok only (verified install + help text). Do not also match grok-build unless a real process basename shows up in the wild
Closed-union exhaustiveness across client/padi Ship the kind arm + fix every satisfies never / .exhaustive() break in the same PR; CI typecheck is the gate

Implementation sketch

packages/integrations/grok/
  package.json                 # name: kolu-grok, exports . + ./schemas
  src/
    config.ts                  # GROK_HOME, paths
    schemas.ts                 # GrokInfoSchema (browser-safe)
    core.ts                    # encodeCwd, readActiveSessions, findSession, foldState
    session-watcher.ts         # fs.watch events.jsonl + summary.json
    agent-adapter.ts           # grokAdapter
    index.ts                   # barrel
    *.test.ts

Wire order for the implementer (so typecheck stays green):

  1. schemas.ts + unit tests for the fold (pure).
  2. anyagent kind/resume/flags (compile breaks surface every switch).
  3. core + session-watcher + agent-adapter.
  4. terminal-workspace schema union + sensors register.
  5. client icon/tables.
  6. e2e fixture + feature.
  7. just fmt + targeted unit/e2e.
